liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- Listener guesses track 3 is Red Haired Boy, track 4 So Many Miles, and track 5 Misery and Pain, with uncertainty [2]
- Track titles per a Billy Strings fan page post via Lucas White: Thirst Mutilator, So Many Miles, Unwanted in Love [3]
- Thirst Mutilator segues into So Many Miles, followed by Unwanted Love, then In Hiding and Freeborn Man [4]

## Setlist highlights

- **Lonesome River**: rare: 11 archived performances [5]
- **Thats What Love Will Make You Do**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 5 archived performances [5]
- **To Lay Me Down**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 13 archived performances [5]

## The recordings

- **billystrings2017-12-31.Neumann** (recommended): source not stated; 7 songs; 54 min; rated 1.67/5 by 3 [1]

## Around the show

- Lindsay Lou appeared as a guest, apparently on the asterisked songs: The Lonesome River, That's What Love Will Make You Do, and To Lay Me Down [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **billystrings2017-12-31.Neumann**: taped by Todd Moore; transferred by Todd Moore; source: Neumann ak 40>lc3>km100> Lunatec v3> sound devices 744t + Neumann km150 >sound devices 744 [1]. Also: Recorded with Neumann mics through a chain of KM100, Lunatec V3 and Sound Devices 744T recorders, plus a Neumann KM150 [1]

## Art and photos

- Poster by thecurtainwithblog.blogspot.com: [Billy Strings - 2017-12-31 Riviera Theatre, Chicago, IL](https://thecurtainwithblog.blogspot.com/2018/11/billy-strings-2017-12-31-riviera.html) [6]
- Poster by thecurtainwithblog.blogspot.com: [Billy Strings - 2017-12-31 Riviera Theatre, Chicago, IL](https://thecurtainwithblog.blogspot.com/2018/11/billy-strings-2017-12-31-riviera.html) [7]
